description: Argentine HR/workforce platform for deskless workers — logistics, manufacturing, retail, healthcare — who lack corporate email and desktop access. 20-module suite (chat, attendance, OKRs, leave, internal comms) reaching 1.6M users across 1,500 companies in 51 countries.
current_status: Post-Series A deploying into Brazil expansion, US entry, and AI agents for employee onboarding. Growing into a TAM of 2.7B deskless workers globally. Backed by Kaszek, Goodwater, Newtopia, YC, Arash Ferdowsi, Marcos Galperin.

founder.name: Geronimo Maspero + team
founder.background: Technical co-founder with enterprise software background. Built Humand from inside the deskless-workforce HR pain — logistics / retail / manufacturing ops that existing Slack-style tools don't serve.
founder.problem_fit: HIGH on the technical layer and workforce-UX insight. MEDIUM on US SaaS distribution — LATAM-first playbook doesn't automatically translate to US HR buyers.
founder.execution_evidence: 1.6M users / 1,500 companies / 51 countries in ~5 years — strong shipping cadence. 20 modules built out before the Series A.
founder.red_flags: None material. The test ahead is US GTM execution, which is a new terrain for this founding team.

stage_context.vs_base: Humand skews thriving (+13pp) given 1.6M users / 51 countries at Series A — well ahead of typical Series A traction. Breakout (+2pp) capped by the US HR SaaS red ocean: Rippling, Ashby, Gem can all ship a deskless SKU in 6 months if the market proves out.

verdict: Humand survives IF (a) multi-module attach rate stays above 3 modules per customer (the integration-moat thesis), (b) US entry CAC does not exceed 24-month LTV (US SaaS HR is the most competitive market on earth), (c) AI-native entrants (Ashby, Gem, Rippling AI) do not ship a deskless SKU before Humand establishes brand. Most fragile: (c) — Rippling already has the platform; adding a deskless module is 6 months of engineering.
top_risk: US SMB HR market has 200+ funded competitors; Humand's LATAM playbook (WhatsApp-native UX, local field sales) may not translate
top_opportunity: AI agents for onboarding on Spanish/Portuguese-dominant workforces is a language-moat that US incumbents are under-invested in
